description: Respiratory Virus Wastewater Surveillance is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. Concentrations of respiratory viruses in the Chicago sewer system as measured at seven sewershed sites since February 2022. In addition to SARS-CoV-2 (the virus that causes COVID-19), concentration data is also available for Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and influenza virus (types A and B). Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Health & Human Services. Its tags are rsv, sanitation, testing, public health, covid-19. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
